levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: The opening «عن إبراهيم بن أبي البلاد» names the book's author as the subject of the book, not a link; the chain runs from «أبي» (the compiler's father) to the author
«و يكنّى أبا إسماعيل» is an editor's gloss, left out
No saying: the report is a chain to a book
